facet_scope: Editorial index of existing detailed evidence. No new specifications, callable model IDs, commercial clearance or performance results. Lists can describe different variants/routes within a family; selection_caveat and the owning detail record govern interpretation.
hosting_scope: Published artifact/runtime requirements and explicitly labeled estimates; no Runpod deployment or inference performed. Unknown configuration and measurements remain null.
